content_en.prompt: Beavers want to make a football like the one in the picture. They have four different options of material to use.
content_en.question: Which material can they use to make the football?
content_en.explanation: Looking at the ball image, all white shapes are 6-sided hexagons and all black shapes are 5-sided pentagons, so options B (uses black hexagons instead of pentagons) and C (uses white triangles instead of hexagons) can be eliminated immediately. There is also only one hexagon edge between any two black pentagons on the ball — this eliminates D, where the black pentagons are separated by at least two hexagon edges. That leaves A, which after verifying does follow both rules, confirming it is correct. (Note: the patterns on A and D don't fit together perfectly because they are a 3D-surface design flattened onto a 2D sheet.)
content_en.ct_explanation: Pattern recognition is one of the cornerstones of computational thinking — recognising patterns within or between problems can make them easier to solve. It is also its own field within informatics: with pattern recognition, computers can recognise or distinguish between objects, in principle the same way humans do. Pattern recognition helps in many fields — e.g. diagnosing disease or predicting disease risk in healthcare, or detecting plant disease and weeds from leaf images in agriculture.

content_zh.prompt: 海狸們想做一顆像圖中這樣的足球。牠們有四種不同的材料可以選擇。
content_zh.question: 牠們該用哪一種材料來做這顆足球？
content_zh.explanation: 觀察足球的圖案，可以馬上看出所有白色圖形都是6邊形，所有黑色圖形都是5邊形。因此可以立刻排除其他選項：選項(B)錯誤，因為它用黑色的6邊形取代了5邊形；選項(C)錯誤，因為它用白色三角形取代了6邊形。我們還可以觀察到，足球上任兩個黑色5邊形之間只隔著一條6邊形的邊——這排除了選項(D)，因為它的黑色5邊形之間隔了至少兩條6邊形的邊。這樣就只剩下選項(A)，驗證它確實同時符合這兩條規則之後，就能確認這是正確答案。（附註：選項(A)和(D)的圖案看起來對不太齊，是因為這是把立體球面上的設計，攤平畫在2D的紙上。）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 樣式辨識是運算思維的基石之一——能辨認出一個問題內部或多個問題之間的樣式，能幫助我們更輕鬆地解決問題。除了是運算思維的基石，樣式辨識本身也是資訊科學裡的一個領域。透過樣式辨識，電腦可以辨認或區分不同的物件，原則上跟人類辨認物體的方式是一樣的。樣式辨識在許多領域都幫助了人類：例如在醫療領域，樣式辨識可以用來輔助診斷疾病、預測患病風險；在農業領域，樣式辨識可以透過葉片影像偵測植物病害和雜草。
